opening.argument: The presenter actively promotes an opportunity by claiming personal earnings and insisting that it “really really works,” while advertising recurring returns of up to eight percent per month. The proposed structure is not a simple investment: viewers are told to use a binary left-and-right system, build a 31-coin grouping, and obtain referral and affiliate fees from that arrangement. Those instructions make recruitment-dependent income central to the solicitation. The activation requirement further undercuts the description’s claim that viewers can try it for free, because the account must be funded with at least one DNC before it can be activated.
